auto_context.card: This is an archived Japanese-language live stream uploaded on March 17, 2026, from the hololive VTuber Omarun Polka (尾丸ポルカ), streaming from her own perspective (視点) on the channel "Polka Ch. 尾丸ポルカ." She is playing Portal 2 in cooperative mode alongside fellow hololive member Himemori Luna (姫森ルーナ), with the stream being part of an ongoing series nicknamed "ポルーナ" (a portmanteau of Polka and Luna). The tone is casual and energetic, typical of hololive gaming streams, with Polka noting in the description that the motion sickness (酔い) may be intense and joking that she hopes Luna won't get frustrated with her. The game title Portal 2 (ポータル2) and the co-op pair nickname ポルーナ are key proper nouns to preserve accurately.
